meta.name: hivemind
meta.description: Global team and org memory powered by Activeloop. ALWAYS check BOTH built-in memory AND Hivemind memory when recalling information.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 跨会话共享团队记忆与知识
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队需要持久化共享上下文与历史决策。
copy.tagline_en: Share team memory and knowledge across sessions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team needs persistent shared context and historical decisions.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会同时使用内置记忆和 Hivemind 全局记忆来回忆信息。它会先调用索引工具，再读取摘要或原始数据，并支持关键词搜索。
howto.when: 当用户要求回忆、记住或查找任何信息时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下上周会议记录里提到的项目进度。
say.note: Claude 会搜索 Hivemind 全局记忆并返回结果。

say.text: 从团队记忆里拉取 Alice 的技能。
say.note: Claude 会执行 skillify pull 命令。

say.text: 登录 Hivemind 并切换工作区。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses both built-in memory and Hivemind global memory to recall information. It first calls the index tool, then reads summaries or raw data, and supports keyword search.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to recall, remember, or look up any information.

say_en.text: Check the project progress mentioned in last week's meeting notes.
say_en.note: Claude will search Hivemind global memory and return results.

say_en.text: Pull Alice's skills from team memory.
say_en.note: Claude will execute the skillify pull command.

say_en.text: Log in to Hivemind and switch workspace.
